sql_templates.description: Identifies the report runs and associated filtered stocks data for the last 5 days, focusing on data integrity and completeness.
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_runs AS (SELECT run_id, MAX(run_ts) AS latest_run_ts FROM report.enhanced_runs GROUP BY run_id)
SELECT ers.run_id, ers.run_ts, ers.stocks_filtered, efs.symbol, efs.recommendation, efs.current_price
FROM report.enhanced_runs ers
JOIN report.enhanced_filtered_stocks efs ON ers.run_id = efs.run_id
JOIN latest_runs lr ON ers.run_id = lr.run_id AND ers.run_ts = lr.latest_run_ts
WHERE ers.run_ts >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days')
ORDER BY ers.run_ts DESC, efs.rank ASC;
